THE EVERYDAY / 01

The beauty of
a small ritual.

There is something generous about giving a familiar moment your full attention. Setting out a shirt. Opening the window. Taking a little more time in front of the mirror.

For Velluti, grooming begins with that kind of attention. Our first styling concept is shaped by an idea of ease: a lightweight feel, natural-looking texture and a simple wash at the end of the day. The final formula is still being developed. The philosophy already has a place in our mornings.

Make a moment of it. Then let the day unfold.

Explore the styling concept ↗

OUR INSPIRATION / 02

Somewhere between
shade and sun.

The Italian spirit that inspires Velluti is an appreciation of atmosphere. Architecture that frames a view. A garden that takes its time. Materials that become more interesting with use.

Warm cream and espresso. Muted olive and aged gold. Watercolour softness beside the clarity of a photograph. We bring these references together to make a visual world that feels both intimate and expansive.

Italian-inspired describes our sensibility. It is not a statement about manufacturing origin. That detail will be confirmed with the final product.

THE DETAILS / 03

Objects worth
making room for.

A good object belongs to its surroundings. It is useful, pleasing to hold and comfortable in the company of the things you already love.

Our packaging concept explores that balance through dark glass, a simple silhouette and a quiet cream label. The light catches the lid. The typography leaves room to breathe. Every detail is part of the same conversation.

These are design studies, not final production specifications. We will share the finished product when it is ready.
